datasets.name: LoanRest
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   C.REST , 
   CM_COMMON.AccountNumber_Get(D.LOANACCID) as ACC_NO
FROM
   CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS B
 , CM_CURR_STATE C
 , CM_ACCOUNTS D
WHERE
     (B.ID =:CreditID)
 AND (D.CREDITID =:CreditID)
 AND (C.CREDITID =:CreditID)

datasets.name: DueRest
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   C.DUEREST , 
   CM_COMMON.AccountNumber_Get(D.DUELOANACCID) as ACC_NO
FROM
   CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS B
 , CM_CURR_STATE C
 , CM_ACCOUNTS D
WHERE
     (B.ID =:CreditID)
 AND (D.CREDITID =:CreditID)
 AND (C.CREDITID =:CreditID)

datasets.name: SReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent, description
  FROM cm_reserves
ORDER BY Percent

datasets.name: CreditInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT 
  RESERVEID ,
 DUERESERVEID ,
 NAME
FROM CM_ACTIVE
WHERE ID=:CREDITID

datasets.name: ExpireData
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, expdate, expamount, intrest
  FROM cm_expires
 WHERE CreditID=:CreditID
